statements.t: Third quarter results were in line with our outlook excluding the tax and tariff benefits, but not where they need to be.

We have realigned the organization around customer-focused segments and expect to have more than 80% of our salaried workforce directly supporting a specific business by year end, up from roughly 40% at the start of the year.
We remain on track for $70 million of annualized SG&A savings by the first quarter of 2027.

We also entered into a purchase agreement to sell Fiberon, are exiting our commercial operations in China, which we expect to be completed by the third quarter of 2027 and are rationalizing the EMEA operating footprint of a business in our Water segment, which we expect to be completed by the fourth quarter of 2027.

“In the fourth quarter, we expect incrementally lower revenue, driven by three things: lower sales from the businesses involved in the portfolio optimization actions, incremental softening in single-family new construction, and a reduction in channel inventory.
“Looking ahead, we see a softer environment for single-family new construction and expect this part of the market to be down mid to high single digits, with R&R down low single digits for the year.
We have also made important decisions on dilutive parts of our portfolio, which we expect will help improve future profitability.
Those businesses will continue to have an impact on our results for the fourth quarter and the first half of next year.
With these factors in mind, we are prudently updating our guidance for net sales and EPS before charges / gains.

We also expect full year operating cash flow and free cash flow to be in the range of $480 million to $500 million and $380 million to $410 million, respectively," said Fortune Brands Chief Financial Officer Pete Clifford.
A recorded replay of the call will be made available on the Company’s website shortly after the call has ended.
The Company will continue to conduct supply chain operations in China.

For the thirteen and thirty-nine weeks ended September 26, 2026, the Company incurred discrete tax charges of $9.2 million ($0.08 per diluted share) related to certain China tax attributes that are no longer expected to be realized as a result of the commercial operations exit.
